tool_args.rationale: All five pilots have H ≤ 0.48, but the forecast target is H = 21.6. The slow-horizon probe directly tests whether adaptation erodes or reverses the early positive gain and helps separate its amplitude from its timescale.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: At short horizons, the slow adaptation term mainly constrains the ratio of its amplitude to its timescale, not the two separately.
Finer short-horizon sampling is less informative about slow adaptation than observing it over a longer horizon.
It omits the observed sink-gradient signature and still needs long-horizon data to constrain the slow term.
